messages:
nightly-alert-bot: ALERT: staging p95 latency +35% vs baseline since 22:08 UTC. Spike started right after deploy 2026-03-19T22:05 (merge 8f3a2c). Observed across short-seq traffic. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/staging/latency/629876

maria: seeing it too. looks like kernel_selector is preferring stream kernels for sub-64 tokens now — weird for this workload

jian: CI smoke also flagged perf regression in kernel-selector tests, job https://ci.redwood/jobs/3421

ci-bot: Job perf-smoke/3421 FAILED — p95 regression +12% compared to baseline. Relevant log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-19T22:06:12Z] p95: 142ms (baseline 127ms)\n
[2026-03-19T22:06:13Z] kernel_selector: selected stream_kernel for model-7b, seq=32\n
[2026-03-19T22:06:13Z] kernel_select::score calc time=18.4ms
```

kevin: running perf-smoke locally. repro with short-seq synthetic load. gprof shows big time in kernel scoring path:
```
flat  accum
  57.2ms  57.2ms  kernel_select::score
  12.4ms  12.4ms  kv_cache::lookup
```

anya: can we bisect to last green? suspects are 8f3a2c (kernel weight refactor) or 7a1b9d (batching tweak). @maria @kevin

maria: starting a bisect on staging VMs, will flip flags and re-run smoke. ETA ~20m

jian: if kernel_selector change is culprit we can pin REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy as a fast guard in rollout policy

kevin: mitigation command if we need it quickly:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy --record
```

canary-bot: Canary update queued to 3 nodes in us-west-2. Will monitor p95 and post results.

maria: bisect update: narrowed to a delta introduced by 8f3a2c — the kernel weight tuning. Repro locally with synthetic short-seq workload when that commit is present

kevin: quick profile after applying commit:
```
select_kernel: p95=57.2ms (prev 12.4ms)
invocations dominated by scoring heuristics for small sequences
```

anya: recommendation: revert 8f3a2c from canary and hold rollout until we add a safety flag. @release @sre please hold train

jian: +1. I'll open a revert PR and add a guard flag behind env var. Pushing PR now

maria: opened PR revert #4852: https://git.redwood/pr/4852 — rolling back canary instances now

canary-bot: Canary rollback applied to 3 nodes. p95 returned to baseline within 2m. Marking alert resolved for now. :white_check_mark: 

maria: leaving a follow-up: add unit test for kernel-score perf and a perf-test in CI to catch this class of regressions. filing ticket now

jian: assign to eng-runtime perf squad. thanks all for quick triage :thumbsup:
